name: omp-memory-guard
description: An oh-my-pi (omp) package that keeps instructions planted in long-term memory from reaching the model as instructions: a write gate on memory tools and handoff documents, an exit gate on the system prompt, a query-result gate that wraps memory read back through tools in nonce-tagged markers, a summary gate on compaction summaries, and a settings overlay that keeps memories out of the prompt.
